answer: A guarantor opens a plot in the registry's orchard only by presenting their relic, their founding attestation. The sponsorship is a cipher naming guarantor, newcomer, and bond, sealed for the registry alone. The k-th identity they back locks $100 times k, held six epochs; a proven fake forfeits the whole bond to the prover. Forging 1,000 puppets through one guarantor locks $50,050,000 ($100 times 1 to 1,000 summed); splitting needs fresh guarantors staking clean relics they cannot mint. An honest newcomer needs one guarantor and a $100 bond, refunded after six clean epochs.
